author: John Gruber
description:
Rohan Goswami and Shelby Talcott, reporting for Semafor this morning:

US President Donald Trump had dialed into Nvidia’s board meeting to argue for Jensen Huang’s return, hours before the company reinstated the ousted CEO, according to people familiar with the matter. [...]

“President Trump was totally involved and this is a great decision by the NVIDIA board. We have to protect our geniuses,” White House communications director Steven Cheung said.

I remember when Republicans were the party that thought the government should stay out of business matters. If you wouldn’t support (say) President Gavin Newsom or Jon Ossoff calling into a Sunday night emergency board meeting to put his thumb on the scale of a hiring decision, you can only support Trump doing it if you’re an avowed hypocrite. title: Semafor: ‘Hours Before Huang’s Reinstatement, Trump Called Nvidia’s Board to Argue for His Return’
